rows.name: S-1 · Stack tree
rows.why: The PRs of a stream as a Git tree, the base at the bottom. The lowest PR has the marker. A tap on a row opens the preview. Variation c puts the card of the lowest PR in the tree.

rows.name: S-2 · Stack cards
rows.why: One card for each PR, the lowest first, with the acts. Approve merges the lowest PR. A higher PR can be pre-approved. Variation b shows all cards in a list.

sketches.caption: After an approve: the next card

rows.name: S-3 · PR preview
rows.why: One PR template has three forms: card, preview and full. The preview shows the context, the summary, the key information, the fields and the acts. The template is a placeholder (O-2). The full form is F4.
